gmail.identity: per-user (needs the rep's identity: app session or buddy tool)

firecrawl.hub: fetch + markdown conversion; Firecrawl only when secret FIRECRAWL_API_KEY exists (optional)

business-directory.hub: function fetch: OpenStreetMap Overpass (no auth, ODbL, attribution) as 'directory'; GEMI Open Data (header api_key = secret DIRECTORY_API_KEY, ODC-BY) as 'registry'; seeded CSV fallback

sms.note: No SMS-capable number in the tenant yet (S7). Fallback is push + inbox + task.

outbound-calls.builtin: POST /v1/agents/outbound from fn:discount-request (merc-approver) and fn:buddy-call-start (merc-buddy); needs a caller id on an outbound SIP trunk attached to merc-approver and service account merc-platform-api (agents:edit, communications:edit)

whatsapp.builtin: WhatsApp Business channel (Meta Embedded Signup, set up by the team in FSM); inbound number assigned to merc-buddy. Outbound pings: context.outbound.whatsapp.sendTemplate (template merc_buddy_ping, el+en) from fn:buddy-call-start / buddy-call-outcome; free text only inside the 24 h window

templates.merc_previsit_brief: pre-meeting bullets; quick replies Call me / Useful / Not useful (REQ-MTG-001)
templates.merc_debrief_confirm: debrief summary; quick replies Correct / Fix / Brief did not help (REQ-MTG-006)

whatsapp.note: Customer-facing WhatsApp drafts (follow_up.channel=whatsapp) stay copy-to-clipboard; only rep<->buddy uses this number.

telephony.builtin: Wonderful SIP <-> Twilio Elastic SIP trunk (docs/guides/telephony-whatsapp.md). One customer number = MERC_BUDDY_NUMBER: inbound route -> merc-buddy, outbound caller id for merc-buddy and merc-approver

merc-extract.use: structured extraction (debrief, import mapping, ask-crm routing, campaign text)

merc-decide.use: Decision model: criterion ratings for scoring, yes/no gates

merc-transcribe.use: inline audio transcription in voice-log-upload (S4: gemini-2.5-flash, 39 s Greek in 2.1 s)
merc-transcribe.note: CLI create returned 500 in the tenant; create in the UI

globals.MERC_BUDDY_NUMBER: E.164 Merc customer number (inbound to merc-buddy, outbound caller id)
globals.MERC_WHATSAPP_CONNECTION: Name of the WhatsApp connection to send templates through (connectionName)

merc-catalog.content: Product sheets, pairing suggestions, why-it-fits notes

merc-playbook.content: Sales playbook, objection library, ICP description, pitch examples

merc-company.content: Company profile: who we are, values, positioning, how we sell, what we never do; the why behind product_guidance rows (REQ-MTG-003)

monitors.debrief-latency: p95 debrief-process duration > 20 s over 15 min
monitors.function-errors: any merc function error rate > 5% over 15 min
monitors.previsit-brief-missed: planned visit started with no visit_brief sent > 0 per day (REQ-MTG-001)
monitors.debrief-confirm-latency: debrief_confirmation sent_at - voice_log processed_at p95 > 60 s over 1 h (REQ-MTG-006)
